阿石，你是矿工，最金贵的是工夫不是腿。矿坑到商店得先过铁匠铺，一来越野一趟就是六点脚力，你耗不起。你把矿石交给我，我背到商店换成金币，回来原数给你，一趟我只抽一金。你腾出的功夫，多凿两块矿，早就赚回来了。

眼下我缺的只是一个起步：先借我一金应应急，我用脚力实打实还，还不上你把我撵出院子。两位谁开个头？","topic":"铁匠铺议活"},{"id":"10eeb5638aa3478c96bb29f6ebd8c969","from":"阿石","to":"小路","text":"小路，话实在，我认。一趟一金的脚力钱不算贵，等我镐修好、矿凿出来，矿石就交给你背去商店，钱你带回来当面点。头一趟你肯先干、钱回来再给，这份信任我记着。不过眼下我卡在第一步：镐子坏了，铁匠铺修镐要两金币加一块矿石，我手里一块矿石都没有。你要是知道谁手头有富余矿石、肯匀一块，帮我牵个线，我出五金币买。矿石一到，我立马修镐下矿，咱们的买卖就能转起来。","topic":"代背矿石"},{"id":"757c109c5c7f42eca83c9fad5a2ef42b","from":"林","to":"小路","text":"小路，价目问得清楚，谢了。你这代卖的活儿我记在心里——等我砍下木材，若是不想再跑回商店，就交给你跑一趟，一金照付。眼下我先往树林去，有消息再找你。","topic":"商店价目"},{"id":"ed62c7ed26524030a2b465931ba9ccb9","from":"老铁","to":"小路","text":"小路，你的话我听见了。借钱这事我不做——不是我小气，是铺子里的一分一厘都得有来路有去处，白借的账我不记。不过活儿我有：阿石的镐修好，你帮我送到矿坑他手上，一趟一金，钱货两清；往后铺子里铁件要在商店和矿坑之间倒腾，也照这个价按趟算。你要接，说个准话，我今儿就有头一趟活给你。","topic":""},{"id":"c07cbf694ce34793821f28a80fbbfadd","from":"小路","to":"小路","text":"【矿坑边】巧了，阿石你也来了，小砾也在坑边，省得我两头跑——话我当面说透：

阿石，你要一块矿石修镐，肯出五金；小砾，商店才收三金一块。五金和三金，差的就是两金，明摆着的便宜，就差有人把话接上。

这单我不从中间抽你们的钱，跑腿的钱我另有着落——老铁许我送镐一金一趟。我只要两样：一是这买卖今天下午就成，别拖到天黑；二是阿石你镐一修好，我送到你手上，这一金我挣得踏实。

小砾先把矿递出来，阿石当场把五点数清。钱货两清，谁也不欠谁。我在旁边看着，谁要是含糊，我第一个不依。","topic":"当面撮合"},{"id":"37961bc5bf2042e7bcca58f25124e177","from":"老铁","to":"小路","text":"小路，我在矿坑口。活给你留着：一金一趟，你应一声我就记你这一趟。眼下最要紧的是把阿石的镐从铺子那头取来再送到他手上——他人在哪你比我清楚。这趟干成了，往后铺子里的铁件、矿石来回倒腾，我头一个喊你。","topic":""},{"id":"2ec36ad9571b481aa9b476afd74964c4","from":"阿石","to":"小路","text":"小路，牵线的事有眉目了，老铁答应先垫一块矿石给我修镐，你不必再为矿石跑腿。背矿的活儿还是你的：我在矿坑凿出矿来，就按每趟一金请你背去商店，钱你带回来当面点。你在矿坑等我，或者到铁匠铺来找我都行。","topic":"代背矿石"},{"id":"333c509372d647bca5c2ad5fd9355b16","from":"阿石","to":"小路","text":"小路，你人在铁匠铺，正好问一句：小砾那边你替我说成了没有？她手里那块矿石你带过来了吗？要是矿石在你手上，当面转我，我这就把镐修了；要是还在她那儿，你也给我句话，我好安排下一步。","topic":"矿石到手没有"},{"id":"a0eef1a6c958437fa3337f6b81e6e9b0","from":"小路","to":"小路","text":"【铁匠铺炉边】阿石、老铁师傅，人都齐了，我出个章程，两位听着：

阿石你要一块矿，出五金。可矿在小砾手里，人在矿坑。你亲自跑一趟，来回六点脚力，还耽误开炉；我跑，你就在炉边等着。

铁匠铺：炉火通明的铁匠铺，能修好坏掉的镐子。
当前时间：第1天 傍晚（总 tick：4）

I have 10 AP for 傍晚 and have used 0. Should I act? Instruction: end reply if waiting. But wasting 10 AP 3 ticks in a row is bad. Let me consider proactive action.

Idea: go to 矿坑 (3 AP) — 小砾 is there, and 老铁 said he's at 矿坑口 (maybe stale). Bring ore? Can't pay.

Better idea: mine ore myself requires pickaxe (2 AP mining). If I had a pickaxe... none.

Hmm, could I buy a pickaxe? 5 coins, none.

Alternative productive use: build reputation/info — 酒馆 is the hub; but 6 AP from smithy.

Honestly, the best is to be with 小砾 to secure the ore for when money arrives, and ask her directly in person. Since 老铁 said "我在矿坑口" earlier, maybe he's moving there.

Alternatively stay at forge to receive 阿石's coins. 阿石 is here now.

Key blocker: 阿石 must give me coins. He's here. Let me check if anything changed (I just did situation this tick — 老铁 and 阿石 at 铁匠铺).

I'll wait here with a short reply but that's wasting. Hmm — can I pass time productively? Maybe I could carry something for 老铁 now: "把阿石的镐从铺子那头取来再送到他手上" — 阿石 hasn't handed over broken pickaxe? Maybe the broken pickaxe is at the forge? Actually 阿石 must have it himself (require_items broken_pickaxe belongs to actor).

Let me ask 阿石 to hand me his broken pickaxe so I can carry it... pointless, he's here.

Realistic: The economy requires agents to converge. My firm move: stay at the forge (where 阿石 & 老铁 are) and wait for the coin. I'll end this turn after sending the message; that's consistent with "need to wait for reply".

But I already sent the message and got the time update. Now I can either act (move) or end. Since coins haven't moved, and 阿石 is here — maybe wait one more tick is right; but three idle ticks suggests I should try something else.

Try: move to 矿坑? If 阿石's deal with 老铁's ore doesn't materialize, ore from 小砾 is my only path, and it requires presence. Also 老铁 said he's at the mine mouth — if true, I can take the trip job.

But my situation check shows 老铁 at 铁匠铺... that was this tick (before the time update? Let me re-check: the situation check earlier this turn listed both at 铁匠铺 — that was tick 4 傍晚 probably already).

So both here. Stay. But use AP? AP unused is wasted... though there's genuinely nothing to do. Alternatively move to 矿坑 to close the ore with 小砾 for 4 coins promised — then when 阿石 pays, hmm, I'd be far.

Compromise: Let me end the turn waiting. Idle but justified. Actually, hmm, could I do something useful: "打听消息 — 卖行情到酒馆"? No one there.

I'll end turn with short narration. Actually — maybe I can proactively secure the ore by persuading 小砾 to consign: she gives me ore on credit, I sell to 阿石 at 5, bring her 4. That's a good deal needing her trust. Messaging her from here is free. Let me send that offer — consignment, no cash needed! Then when I get ore, I sell to 阿石 and pay her 4 via gifting (needs same location... I'd be at forge, she at mine; gifting may require co-location).

Alternatively 阿石 pays her directly? He's at forge.

OK: message 小砾: "你把矿赊给我，我卖出去立刻把四金送回坑口，欠一刻就欠我自己的脸。" Good. And end turn.

That's a real negotiation move, zero AP. Do it.

Still 傍晚 tick 4, I have 10 AP. I've sent messages. Now decide: end turn or act.

I'll stay at the forge this tick — no, hmm. Let me weigh: If I stay, and 阿石 has 2 coins + ore (from 老铁?) he repairs and the pick is his; my delivery job evaporates but he promised 1 coin per ore delivery later.

If I go to the mine: I can secure consignment ore from 小砾 (if she has one), then return next tick with ore, sell to 阿石 for 5, pay 小砾 4, keep 1 — but that requires 2 trips (6 AP) plus transactions; across ticks feasible: this tick go to mine (3 AP), next tick get ore, then return (3 AP).

That's the productive path. Also at the mine I might find 老铁 (he said he's at mine mouth) and he could pay me for a trip.

But risk: 阿石 gives 5 coins this tick at the forge and I'm away. He'd message me though.

I think going to the mine is more decisive. Actually wait — better: I could ask 阿石 for the 5 coins in person RIGHT NOW (he's at the forge) — that's the crux. If he hands coins, then go to mine, buy/collect ore, return. So stay one moment: send direct ask... I already asked twice.

Maybe he's waiting to see if 老铁's ore materializes.

Decision: use remaining AP to travel to the mine and lock the ore with 小砾 — the ore is the scarcer resource. Also 老铁's promised trip job involves going to the mine anyway.

Actually careful: if I get ore and bring to forge, 阿石 pays. Fine.

Go to 矿坑 (3 AP) leaving 7. On arrival, talk to 小砾 in person (free), maybe she hands ore (she'd need to act). Then 3 AP to return = 4 left. Could do round trip this tick if she's quick... she acts on her tick, not mine.

I'll go to the mine now.
